# Hash-locked dependency set for the release job (r4 b2-sol R61).
# The semantic-release stack runs with the repo-write App token, so every
# package it imports must be exact-pinned AND hash-verified -- an unpinned
# transitive is arbitrary code with push access. `build` is locked here too
# (grind r5, P9/R61): build_command formerly ran its own unhashed
# `pip install build==` INSIDE the token scope, escaping this lock.
# python-semantic-release is pinned at >=10.6.2 (not 9.21.1/9.21.2): GitPython
# 3.1.60 (PYSEC-2026-3982..3984 fix, c3de3f522) removed Actor.name_email_regex,
# which every python-semantic-release 9.x release through 9.21.2 still reads at
# config-load time; the read was replaced with internal validation in 10.6.2
# (upstream issue #1476). Do not pin psr back to a 9.x release without first
# confirming it no longer reads that removed GitPython attribute.
# Regenerate (and re-review the diff) with:
#   uv pip compile --generate-hashes --python-version 3.11 \
#     --python-platform x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
#     <(echo 'python-semantic-release==10.7.0'; echo 'build==1.5.0'; \
#        echo 'setuptools>=83') \
#     -o .github/workflows/release-requirements.txt
annotated-types==0.8.0 \
